name: GSJ 1/1 000 000
licence: Unclear: GSJ site licence (Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use 2.0, commercial OK, https://www.gsj.jp/license/license.html) vs WMS capabilities AccessConstraints 'personal, teaching, research or non-commercial use'
attribution: 1:1,000,000 Geological Map of Japan, 3rd ed. (© Geological Survey of Japan, AIST)
notes: Technically OK: WMTS REST template from https://ows.gsj.jp/tilemap/geologicmap/wmts/1.0.0/WMTSCapabilities.xml, TileMatrixSet EPSG900913 = Google grid 256 px, TileMatrix ids are zero-padded '00'..'18' but unpadded z works too (z=5 and z=05 return identical bytes). Tiles served to z17 at the test site (z18 fully transparent). Tiles are slightly translucent (alpha ~214-255). Outside coverage: 256x256 fully transparent PNG. to_check because the sibling WMS (https://ows.gsj.jp/ows/GSJ_Combined_Bedrock_and_Superficial_Geology_and_Age/wms) GetCapabilities AccessConstraints says 'available for free download for your personal, teaching, research or non-commercial use' (legacy OneGeology wording), contradicting the GSJ site-wide licence; ask GSJ (publish@gsj.jp) which applies. Redundant with geology_gsj_200k for display anyway.
